svg.aria-label: Detection pipeline: Cisco syslog, OPNsense and Suricata IDS alerts, Windows Server event logs and Proxmox and Linux agents feed Wazuh, which decodes, correlates and responds, and forwards events to Splunk for search and dashboards. An attack flagged by Suricata is correlated by Wazuh, which raises a level 10 SSH brute force alert and blocks the source.
svg.title: Detection pipeline
